summary_en: Macbee Planet will acquire all issued shares of J.C. & G., a credit installment service provider established in 2004, to integrate payment and financial services capabilities with its existing customer base and apply its LTV prediction analytics to credit screening.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of All Shares of J.C. & G. Co., Ltd. (Full Subsidiary Status)
translation_en_brief:
On October 14, 2026, Macbee Planet's Board of Directors resolved to acquire all issued shares of J.C. & G. Co., Ltd., a credit installment service provider, and make it a wholly owned subsidiary. J.C. & G. has operated credit purchase installment services under the Installment Sales Act since its establishment in March 2004, primarily serving the beauty and medical treatment sectors.

The acquisition is motivated by three strategic objectives. First, it enables Macbee Planet to offer payment and financial services to its existing customer base, thereby expanding the value proposition to clients. Second, the company plans to apply its proprietary LTV prediction and data analytics technology to credit screening processes, improving assessment accuracy and operational efficiency. Third, diversifying revenue sources by combining performance-based marketing support fees with installment service commissions will enhance earnings stability and resilience.

As of March 26, 2026, J.C. & G. reported total assets of 4,367,098 thousand yen, net assets of 312,502 thousand yen, and net profit of 44,464 thousand yen for the fiscal year. Admiral Fund 3 Investment Partnership currently holds 100% of the company's shares.
